references.text: Manoah had previously asked God that the man should return to teach them how to raise the child, which directly leads to this question.
The Nazirite vow described here provides background for the 'ordinances' (mishpat) that Manoah asks about regarding the upbringing of his son.
Manoah continues to ask questions of the angel, including asking for his name, showing his desire to understand more about what has been promised.
Similar questions were asked at the birth of John the Baptist: 'What will become of this child?' - a parallel theme concerning a special child with a divine calling.
Rebekah also asked the Lord about her children and received guidance regarding their future, just as Manoah seeks guidance about the upbringing of his coming son.
